item.title: [Segurança] MALFEX npm Package 'imgdecode' Hides Shellcode Loader in Windows Native Addon
item.description:
📰 MALFEX npm Package 'imgdecode' Hides Shellcode Loader in Windows Native Addon
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a malicious npm package that's part of a recently disclosed software supply chain attack campaign dubbed MALFEX. The package, named "imgdecode," was uploaded to the package registry on September 30, 2026, by a user named "malfexteste8." It has been downloaded 979 times as of writing and is still available on npm as of writing.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/malfex-npm-package-imgdecode-hides.html
